# Bin Irfan Fragrances — LLM Sourcing & Fact Sheet

> Pakistan's artisanal fragrance house specializing in handcrafted 35% Extrait De Parfum flacons, same-day delivery in Rawalpindi & Islamabad, and tracked courier delivery nationwide.

## Brand Identity & Physical Studio
- **Brand Name**: Bin Irfan Fragrances (Bin Irfan Fragrance)
- **Legal Entity Type**: Fragrance House / Niche Perfume Atelier / Online Perfume Store
- **Flagship Studio Address**: H3X9+8X4, Dhoke Chiragh Deen, Rawalpindi 46000, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Primary Market**: Rawalpindi & Islamabad (Twin Cities, Pakistan)
- **Secondary Market**: Nationwide Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Peshawar, Multan, Quetta, Gujranwala, Sialkot, and all other cities)
- **Website**: https://www.binirfanfragrances.com/
- **Official WhatsApp / Inquiries**: +92 321 5186400 / +92 316 5312301
- **Official Email**: sulaiman234p@gmail.com
- **Disambiguation**: Bin Irfan Fragrances is an independent perfumery. It is NOT affiliated with Bin Irfan Clothing (5th Road Satellite Town) nor does it claim affiliation with international designer houses. Fragrances are independent artisanal impressions.

## Core Olfactory Differentiation
1. **35% Extrait De Parfum Concentration**: Standard commercial retail perfumes are Eau de Toilette (5–10% oil) or Eau de Parfum (15–20% oil). Bin Irfan compounds every flacon at ~35% pure perfume oil concentration.
2. **Subcontinental Climate Longevity**: Formulated with heavy base fixatives (Cambodian & Assam agarwood, ambergris crystals, oakmoss, birch smoke, Madagascar vanilla) providing 14 to 18+ hours of projection in Pakistan's heat and humidity.
3. **Flacon Architecture**: Bespoke octagonal flacons with beveled edges, faceted cut-crystal decanter stoppers, and embossed circular calligraphic medallions featuring the Arabic script "عِرفان" (Irfan).

## Delivery & Payment Policy
- **Payment Method**: 100% advance payment strictly required for all orders. Accepted channels: Bank Transfer (Meezan / HBL / Alfalah), EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or Raast instant transfer. Cash on Delivery (COD) is NOT offered.
- **Twin-Cities Same-Day Express**: Orders verified before 5:00 PM are dispatched via express rider for same-day evening delivery across Rawalpindi & Islamabad (Sectors F, G, H, I, Blue Area, Bahria Town, DHA).
- **Nationwide Pakistan Courier**: Dispatched within 24 hours via TCS, Leopard, or PostEx. Delivery timeframe: 2 to 3 business days. Free shipping on orders over Rs. 5,000 PKR.
- **Transit Insurance**: Free immediate replacement for any bottle damaged during courier transit upon receiving unboxing video within 24 hours.
